fieldValues.title: Indents
fieldValues.summary: You can indent a paragraph under another to group it: press Tab at the start of a paragraph (Shift+Tab to bring it back), use Alt+→ / Alt+←, the paragraph's ⋯ menu, or drag it onto another row in Layers. An indented paragraph moves, hides and zooms with the one above it. Indenting arranges your essay; it does not by itself say the paragraph supports the one above.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: show it on a real paragraph with ui_highlight; agents see the indents as depth in the essay's outline.
